## For players, please update the mod to v1.1.2 (Guardian Souls fix for checks normally requiring Guardian Kills)

# Changelogs 
*v1.1.2*
- Added IBBoat to IBMain exit logic when CanSealCorridor is met
- Moved some locations from HLSpun to HL as they could be obtained early through ER
- Added some vertical attacking logic with Whip + Spaulder
- Fixed a generation issue where Cliff is unreachable

*v1.1.1*
- New option: Alpha implemented of Guardian Souls 
  - Bosses no longer affect Soul Gates, instead 9 Soul items are added to the pool
  - Bosses have 1 additional check upon defeating them
- QoL toggle: Infinite Starting Weapon Ammo 
- QoL toggle: Red tint on unchecked AP pots
- QoL toggle: hovering AP icon over enemy & npc glossary

*v1.1.0*
- Added "progressive useful" tagging for items that often lead to large location access / go mode.
- Split Require FDC and Required Totem (for DLC)
- Enemy Glossary accessibility now takes world difficulty scaling into logic
  - This makes Harp and Ganesha's Talisman progressive as they affect the scaling
- Non-vanilla soul gate values can now be set (full range from 0 to 9)
- With Random Dissonance, sealing the corridor now only requires the charged Beherit
  - The Required Guardians requirement is enforced through the Spiral Boat soul gate value 
  - This allows any post-Ragnarok checks to be in logic before meeting the Required Guardians
- Some minor logic corrections and additions
